'''2007 Worlds Team PMJ DS You Cannot Hide Forever''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Patrick Johnson|PMJ]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Patrick Johnson|PMJ]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Cannot Hide Forever & •Mobilization Points|Cor-D-youcannothideforever&mobilizationpoints.gif|label=You Cannot Hide Forever}}
* '''Stage:''' Team
